eyebrow: TELVERGENCE × TELVERGE · The vanity & Smart-DID platform
tagline: A number people remember is worth more than a number people look up. TELVERGE is the vanity and Smart-DID platform — spell your business into a toll-free number, put your name on the caller ID, and let a 24/7 AI answer every call it brings in. Ten Smart-DID lines for $22.95 each.
demoNote: Vanity & Smart-DID platform · toll-free · branded caller ID · AI answer · 10-line pack · numbers pending assignment
insight: a memorable number is the cheapest permanent advertising a business will ever own — it works on a truck, a sign, a radio spot, and a business card simultaneously, forever, and it never stops compounding. But a vanity number that rings into voicemail wastes every impression it earns. The number and the answering have to be one system. That's a Smart DID.

dids.p: The front door — the number the whole brand is built on.
The always-on answering layer every other line falls back to.
New business routed straight to a closer.
Existing customers adding lines — fast path, no queue.
The core offer's own tracked line.
Absorbs surge for any client whose own lines are saturated.
Auto-callback for every call that didn't connect.
The compliant outbound face — branded and recorded.

pillars.p: A compliant dialer with branded caller-ID so your name shows on every call — recordings, callbacks, DNC-scrubbed lists.
Every vanity line backed by 24/7 AI answer + SMS. Every source measured, every missed call auto-called-back.
Calls, texts, conversions, ad spend and source — one live dashboard across every number you own.

commandCenter.note: Every call feeds a real-time conduit your customized "second brain" analyzes on the fly — then you, or the AI, adjust the leads, script, offer, territory, or channel instantly and watch your P&L move. You do the work — we make the phone ring.
